topic: Perioperative management of RA: holding DMARDs and biologics for surgery

source.title: Perioperative management of immunosuppression in patients with rheumatoid arthritis
source.whyItFits: Open review of perioperative DMARD and biologic management in rheumatoid arthritis that restates the ACR/AAHKS hold-versus-continue recommendations with dosing-interval examples.

whyItFits: Open review of perioperative DMARD and biologic management in rheumatoid arthritis that restates the ACR/AAHKS hold-versus-continue recommendations with dosing-interval examples.
coverageNote: Gives continue-versus-hold rules and two biologic examples. The 2022 ACR/AAHKS update was not an open PMC full text, so newer changes after 2019 are not added.
rejectedInAppHints: An IBD perioperative or anticoagulation paper was not accepted as the RA DMARD guidance.
